notes.title: Ver.1.4 Update
notes.content: [p]Ver.1.4  Update[/p][p][/p][p]We have released Ver.1.4 today, addressing the following bug fixes and adjustments:[/p][p][/p][p]・Corrected an image error with Valberzard’s portrait in EP.1 Part A.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue in EP.1 Part A where the time display in the upper-left corner would incorrectly switch from “9 minutes” to “8 minutes.”[/p][p]・Corrected an image error in EP.1 Part A affecting Treffy’s face graphic during the scene in which Mandibot disappears.[/p][p]・Updated the sponsor screen displayed at the end of EP.4.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely appreciate your continued support for the Kokoro Clover series.[/p]

notes.title: Ver.1.3 Mini Update
notes.content:
[code]Ver.1.3 Mini Update
A minor update has been released today, including bug fixes and adjustments.

Fixed an issue where skipping the opening scene when rewatching EP.1 would briefly show the intro scene before skipping, instead of jumping directly to the commercial as intended

Fixed an issue in EP.2 where, after selecting Trefi and returning to the character select screen, choosing Phantom Bavaroa would result in Ultol being selected (only occurs on first attempt)

Adjusted some of Tyrannosaurus’s animations

Added a new cutscene for Dinotrigger in EP.4 Part B

Various minor image fixes

Thank you for your continued support of the Kokoro Clover series.

notes.title: Ver.1.2 Minor Update
notes.content: [p]This is a machine translation.[/p][p][/p][p]An update was released today, including bug fixes and adjustments.[/p][p]Starting with this update, the version number will now be displayed in the upper-left corner of the title screen. (Initial version display will be Ver.1.2)[/p][p]Additionally, internal changes have been made in preparation for the release of the Nintendo Switch version on June 19. However, there are no visible changes to the STEAM version.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179880/1ce4cec16fb295ad1e00b9699dd6345b1c94f0a0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Overall Game[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue where the “+”, “START”, “OPTION”, and “N” keys were not functioning due to a bug; they have now been enabled.[/p][p](These are used for displaying the logo in scenarios and for opening the menu during boss battles.)[/p][p]As a result, the previously implemented temporary substitutes—the “ZR” and “ZL” buttons, and the “U” and “O” keys—have been removed.[/p][p][/p][p]Previously, clearing the Boss Rush with one type of Ulfur Thor would cause all Ulfur Thor-type characters to receive a gold trophy.[/p][p]This has been changed so that only the Ulfur Thor type that was actually cleared receives a gold trophy; all others will now show silver trophies if not yet cleared.[/p][p](After the update, if you have already cleared the Boss Rush with one Ulfur Thor, only that specific Ulfur Thor will display a gold trophy. Other Ulfur Thor types will need to be cleared individually again to earn their respective gold trophies.)[/p][p][/p][p][b]■ HOME Screen[/b][/p][p]Added version number display to the upper-left corner of the title screen (Initial display will be Ver.1.2)[/p][p]Fixed an image error on the HOME screen (misplaced character in “Story”)[/p][p]Fixed a bug where the mission display would incorrectly appear in the top right corner when changing the language[/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Story[/b][/p][p]Fixed an image issue in the strong wind scene of 2A[/p][p]Fixed a background image misalignment in 3A[/p][p]Fixed a character white border issue in 3B[/p][p]Fixed a cursor display issue in the 4B scene[/p][p]Fixed incorrect time display in 2B[/p][p]Fixed incorrect time display in 4B[/p][p]Fixed a bug where the recap could not be skipped on subsequent viewings[/p][p]Fixed missing shadow in Skoll’s “holding the book” animation[/p][p]Fixed an image issue in Phantom Thief Black Cherry - Snipe-ptera’s victory animation[/p][p]Fixed an image issue in Phantom Thief Black Cherry’s victory animation after clearing Boss Rush[/p][p][/p][p]■ Boss Rush[/p][p]Fixed a bug in the English version where returning to the HOME screen from Boss Rush character selection would incorrectly take you to the Story Mode selection screen[/p][p][/p][p]■ Library[/p][p]Fixed a bug where selecting “Fossil” from “Shining Treffy” in the character encyclopedia would result in a locked icon, preventing selection[/p][p]Fixed an issue in the English version where character descriptions overflowed their text boxes[/p][p]Added missing age information in the English description for “Perzik”[/p][p]Fixed a bug where “OP (Season 1)” in the Animation section could not be played unless the cursor was moved[/p][p]Adjusted behavior so that after watching a video in the Animation section, the screen now returns to the Animation selection instead of the Library[/p][p][/p][p]■ Internal Adjustments for Switch Version (No visible changes for the STEAM version)[/p][p]Changed the commercial video played during the following episodes from “Kokoro Clover Season 1” to “Kokoro Clover SUN”[/p][p]EP.1[/p][p]EP.2[/p][p]EP.4[/p][p]Removed the “Library” and “Series” categories[/p][p]Removed the “CM (S1)” item from “Library” > “Animation”[/p][p]Updated the sponsor screen displayed after clearing EP.4[/p][p]Renamed “Boss Rush” and “Season 1 Boss Rush” to “S1 Boss Rush”[/p][p]Renamed “OP (Season 1)” under “Library” > “Animation” to “OP (S1)”[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of the Cocoro Clover series.[/p]
